content.short: Mintpark is a Bitcoin Layer 2 NFT marketplace for launching, trading, and bridging Bitcoin NFTs.
content.description: Mintpark is an NFT marketplace engineered for Bitcoin Layer 2 networks, enabling launch, trading, and bridging of NFTs across BTC L2s. It wraps Bitcoin NFTs into secure, tradable assets on modern networks, marrying Bitcoin’s reliability with fast, intuitive tools for creators and collectors. With support for EVM launches, cross‑chain trading, and portfolio management, Mintpark powers the future of Bitcoin NFTs.
